doc: The vehicle standard as data (docs/development/vehicle-standard.md; the owner's card of 27 Nov 2026: 'An audit kind'). scripts/vehicle-bindings.py's audit reads it against D'thorga Framework's bindings report, so it checks what the game really bound. 'kinds' sorts each vehicle into one kind, the first match winning; 'lines' says what every vehicle of a kind must show; a line marked 'planned' is listed as still to come, not as a fault; 'except' excuses one vehicle from one line, with why. A next game's vehicles would be a file like this one beside its own report.

kinds.why: Our trailer loadouts; a towed thing with no engine of its own.
The water and fuel bowsers are trailers too.
A rotor drive: helicopters, and the tiltrotor and turboprop transports our loadouts give one.
Flight controls and no rotor drive.
Our submarines: no line applies while submarine work is on the owner's back burner (20 Nov 2026); D'thorga Framework leaves the boats' radio bays and the Comms system off them.

lines.label: each engine's own fuel feed and fuel pump
each engine's own oil and oil pump

except.why: A thrust-lifted pod on fictional chemfuel thrusters (Vanilla Vehicles Expanded), not jet engines: a thruster, like a rocket, has no oil sump, and chemfuel is not jet fuel (the owner's card of 28 Nov 2026, 'Excuse them, recorded').
